project: 高级感P/视觉审美操作系统
scope: Only one independent 风 glyph sketch-first visual test. This does not reopen stopped 三点失眠 experiments or modify the native mainline task.

prior_baseline.current_user_verdict: No user approval; previous internal art-direction FAIL: geometric, stiff and heavy hooks.

reference_research.learned: Stroke pressure and lifting, turning dynamics, stroke order and interstroke connection explain real brush character; arbitrary simulated dry brush and smooth geometry are not enough.
reference_research.note: Research informed instructions/concept only. The generated image was NOT produced by digitizing a human calligrapher's actual hand movement. Do not claim true hand-writing capture.

image_generation.role: Synthetic draft quality anchor, NOT a human hand-brushed original; original raster still present as conversation artifact, but was not saved into Google Drive and was not inserted into Figma as the original high-resolution bitmap.

vectorization.actual_figma_import_method: OpenCV threshold 140 on luminance and findContours; selected six largest meaningful components, approximated each contour with approxPolyDP epsilon=3.5 px; even-odd vector path assembled into SVG; imported via Figma createNodeFromSvg.
vectorization.internal_local_alternative_note: An offline 43-contour simplification gave 94.15% binary silhouette overlap; it was NOT the version imported into Figma. Do not attribute that metric to the Figma import.
vectorization.important_limits: IoU is measured against a binarized generated raster and does not measure aesthetic quality; white paper/gray ink gradations and small flywhite details were lost.

figma.verification: Separate live Figma API readback after import confirmed new page, old source clone with 5 native VECTOR children, new imported SVG frame with one editable VECTOR, and screenshot of both side-by-side.

assessment.observed_improvement: Compared with the old geometric glyph, the new synthetic draft has better thick/thin variation, brushlike endings, directional movement, dramatic negative space and visual energy.
assessment.observed_defects: The internal structure no longer reads unambiguously as simplified 风 at a glance; right hook is oversized; black/white tracing discards fine ink gradations. It has not been blind-reviewed or approved by user.
assessment.role: Experimental visual candidate, not a finished wordmark or a proven automated lettering system.

protections.prior_user_stop: 三点失眠 remains STOPPED_BY_HUMAN; no attempts were made to modify it.
protections.mainline: Task lock revision355/checkpoint377 not written or advanced.

next: Present the actual Figma two-version comparison for the user's direct aesthetic judgment. Do not claim handwriting authenticity, content accuracy, or production readiness. Further production would require the user to approve legibility and visual direction.
